title: Zhongdex Core 3000 — HSK words inside the top 3000
oneLiner: The HSK 3.0 (2026) words that rank in the 3000 most frequent Chinese words overall. This is fewer than 3000 cards, by design — see the description.
description: Frequency rank here is global: it is measured across 118,765 upstream headwords, most of which are proper nouns, variants and function words that the HSK syllabus does not list. This pack is the intersection — every HSK 3.0 (2026) headword whose global rank is 3000 or better — so it deliberately contains materially fewer than 3000 words. The `size` field is the real card count; the 3000 in the name is the frequency cutoff, not a quantity. Words whose frequency rank is unknown cannot appear in any Core pack at all; the canon's coverage figures record how many that is.
rationale: 'Core 3000' is a query people type, so the pack keeps the name. What it must not do is let the name imply a card count it does not deliver — a learner who expects 3000 cards and receives fewer has been misled by the title, which is why the arithmetic is stated three times before anyone opens the file.

provenance.rule: The headword has a known global frequency rank of 3000 or better.
